items.summary_ko: 선택적 예측 시스템은 모호한 사례를 인간 전문가에게 위임하여 임상 AI의 안전성을 향상시키지만, 불확실성 점수가 임상적 모호성을 정확하게 반영해야 한다는 전제에 전적으로 의존합니다. 이 연구는 심각한 클래스 불균형이 특징인 예후 작업에서 이러한 가정이 무너지는 경우의 구조적 취약성과 교정 방법을 탐구합니다.
items.why_ko: 의료 AI 시스템의 안전성과 신뢰성을 높이는 데 필수적인 불확실성 정량화 문제를 해결하고, 특히 데이터 불균형 상황에서 모델의 오작동을 방지하는 데 중요한 기여를 합니다.

items.title: Collective Dynamics of Self-Reinforcement: How Cross-Task Coupling Drives Policy Collapse in Unsupervised RLVR
items.body: Label-free reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) rewards a language model for agreeing with its own majority vote. It improves reasoning at first but eventually collapses: the self-assessed reward goes to one while accuracy falls, often until the model gives the same answer to every problem. The collapse appears only when training uses many problems. We explain this dataset-size dependence as a collective instability. In a solvable many-problem model in which problems share parameters, a population whose problems prefer different answers amplifies any shared perturbation for as long as the population-averaged slope $\langle F'\rangle$ of the single-problem self-reinforcement drift $F$ is positive. This holds while problems are still uncertain about their answers. Per-problem sharpening, slowed by $1/N$ for $N$ training problems, races against the shared mode, which grows at a rate $\proptoλ^2$ independent of $N$, where $λ$ is the strength of the shared coupling. This yields a critical number of problems $N_c\simeq\ln(1/δ)/(λ^2G)$, where $δ$ seeds the shared mode and $G$ decreases with the initial confidence. Simulations of the model confirm the predictions: a sharp transition, $N_c\proptoλ^{-2}$ up to a logarithmic correction, a single critical amplification $λ^2NG$ across couplings, confidence profiles and training variants, a logarithmic dependence on batch size, and no collapse for confident initial models. A kernel version of the theory identifies a protective coupling (generalization of sharpening) and a marginal-entropy bonus that stabilizes the uniform collective mode. In label-free RL of a small Transformer, removing the shared direction prevents collapse entirely, restoring it causes collapse, and collapse grows with training-set size and base-model entropy.
items.title_ko: 자기 강화의 집단 역학: 교차 작업 결합이 자율 RLVR에서 정책 붕괴를 유발하는 방법
items.summary_ko: 레이블 없는 검증 가능한 보상 강화 학습(RLVR)은 자체 다수결 동의에 대해 언어 모델에 보상을 부여합니다. 처음에는 추론을 개선하지만, 결국 모델이 모든 문제에 동일한 답변을 제공할 때까지 자기 평가 보상이 1로 수렴하면서 정확도가 떨어지는 붕괴 현상이 발생합니다. 이 연구는 이러한 데이터셋 크기 의존성 붕괴를 집단 불안정성으로 설명합니다.
items.why_ko: 자기 강화 학습 시스템의 불안정성 문제를 이해하고, 대규모 데이터셋에서의 훈련 시 발생하는 정책 붕괴 현상을 예방하는 데 중요한 통찰을 제공합니다.

items.title: Kinematic Constraint-Referenced Evaluation for Articulated Object Manipulation
items.body: Manipulation policies are evaluated predominantly by binary task success, which cannot tell whether the commanded gesture is the one the object's kinematics admit. We introduce Constraint-Referenced Strategy (CRS), which projects the commanded end-effector twist onto the object's joint axis, separating progress along the joint from off-constraint waste. CRS requires a joint model and a joint-following scripted controller derived from it, but no recorded demonstration or learned judge. On 74 simulated articulated objects, success registers three transfer failures as lower rates but attributes none, while the two CRS channels give each a distinct signature. A door-trained behavior-cloning policy opens drawers in 59 of 110 episodes, and in these passes it commands about $40\times$ the off-axis rotation of a drawer-trained policy's passes ($1.27$ vs.\ $0.032$~rad/s). Relative to a scripted controller scored with the same axis, CRS verdicts are unchanged under joint-axis errors up to $30^\circ$; absolute thresholds tolerate about $8^\circ$.
items.title_ko: 관절형 객체 조작을 위한 운동학적 제약 참조 평가
items.summary_ko: 로봇 조작 정책은 주로 이진 작업 성공 여부로 평가되지만, 이는 객체의 운동학적 제약을 얼마나 잘 따르는지 알려주지 않습니다. CRS(Constraint-Referenced Strategy)는 명령된 말단 효과기 트위스트를 객체의 조인트 축에 투영하여, 조인트 진행과 제약 이탈 낭비를 분리합니다.
items.why_ko: 로봇 조작 정책의 정밀도를 향상시키고, 복잡한 관절형 객체를 다루는 로봇의 실제 환경 적용에 필수적인 평가 방법을 제공합니다.

items.title: When, Where, and What to Correct: Human-Guided Adaptive Residual Correction for Robot Policies
items.body: Imitation policies that reliably execute most of a manipulation trajectory can still fail in localized regions requiring last-mile precision. Updating the full policy or exploring residual actions everywhere treats this local failure as a global learning problem. We introduce Adaptive Residual Correction (ARC), a lightweight post-training module that uses reinforcement learning (RL) to learn a residual correction on top of a frozen policy while using sparse human corrections to structure autonomous exploration. Rather than treating human corrections as imitation targets, ARC uses pre-intervention states to determine 'when' residual control should become active and correction geometry to determine 'where' in residual action space autonomous refinement should explore; task reward determines 'what' residual is ultimately executed. Across three precision-manipulation tasks on a real robot, ARC improves average task success from 33.3% to 75.0%. The human corrections define task-dependent 2-3 dimensional subspaces of the seven-joint residual space that retain 96.0-97.7% of squared correction magnitude. Together, these results show that sparse human corrections can localize and constrain autonomous post-training without requiring the observed correction itself to serve as the final action target.
items.title_ko: 언제, 어디서, 무엇을 수정할 것인가: 인간이 안내하는 로봇 정책의 적응형 잔차 보정
items.summary_ko: 모방 정책은 조작 궤적의 대부분을 안정적으로 실행하지만, 마지막 정밀도가 필요한 국부적인 영역에서 실패할 수 있습니다. ARC(Adaptive Residual Correction)는 강화 학습을 사용하여 고정된 정책 위에 잔차 보정을 학습하는 경량의 후처리 모듈이며, 희소한 인간 교정을 활용하여 자율 학습을 구조화합니다.
items.why_ko: 로봇 정책의 실용적인 배포를 위해 필수적인 '마지막 마일' 정밀도 문제를 해결하고, 인간의 개입을 최소화하면서 로봇이 자율적으로 오류를 수정하고 학습하는 방법을 제공합니다.

items.title: GroundControl: Satellite-Conditioned Multi-View Diffusion for Reconstruction-Free Novel View Synthesis
items.body: Multi-view or video diffusion models have recently emerged as state-of-the-art approaches for novel-view synthesis from sparse image collections. While they can produce high quality images, they tend to hallucinate unrealistic spatial layouts when synthesizing views outside the input views (scene extrapolation). We propose to address this challenge for outdoor scenes by using satellite images as an additional information source to condition the multi-view generative model. We introduce a new satellite-conditioned multi-view diffusion model that combines conditioning from a satellite image and street-level input images when generating novel-views. Our cross-attention based conditioning allows us to retain pretrained multi-view diffusion priors to generate seamless, realistic, novel views from a handful of source views, while also adhering to the scene layout as seen from satellite images. Our model does not use 3D scene reconstruction, and only relies on posed street and satellite views. Our experiments on outdoor datasets show that our model is better than both satellite-conditioned or street-view conditioned baselines on novel-view synthesis, especially on challenging cases where target views have very little overlap with source views. Project page: https://nianticspatial.github.io/groundcontrol
items.title_ko: GroundControl: 재구성 없는 새로운 뷰 합성을 위한 위성 조건 다중 뷰 확산 모델
items.summary_ko: GroundControl은 위성 이미지를 추가 정보 소스로 사용하여 다중 뷰 생성 모델을 조건화함으로써, 야외 장면에서 새로운 뷰 합성 시 비현실적인 공간 레이아웃을 환각하는 문제를 해결합니다. 이는 기존의 다중 뷰 확산 모델이 입력 뷰 외부를 합성할 때 발생하는 문제를 개선합니다.
items.why_ko: 야외 장면의 새로운 뷰 합성에 대한 정확성과 현실감을 크게 향상시켜, 가상 현실, 지도 생성, 도시 계획 등 다양한 지리 공간 애플리케이션에 활용될 수 있습니다.

items.title: Which Hand Was Late? Diagnosis for Robot Failure Recovery in Bimanual Tool Use
items.body: Failure diagnosers for robot manipulation are increasingly vision--language models (VLMs), trained and evaluated on single-arm failures produced by perturbing a successful demonstration. Bimanual tool use adds failures of other kinds: a tool that slips out of its socket while still held, two correct gestures made at different times, and attempts that fail for two reasons at once. On a simulated bimanual tool-use task whose failure causes are read from the recorded trace, we measure what each sensing channel lets a diagnoser tell. The tool's slip is read on the tool hand; which hand was late is read on both arms, while a sensor on one hand reads its own hand's delay and at most part of the other's; and whether a late attempt was also pushed too weakly is not identifiable from passive sensing when the tool hand is late. Within two attempts, a repair policy that escalates when the cause is not identifiable repairs as many failures as one told the true cause. A VLM's internal state carries the late hand almost perfectly, along a direction no closer to the one its answer reads than a random one; whether the answer reports it depends on the wording of the question.
items.title_ko: 어떤 손이 늦었는가? 양손 도구 사용 로봇 고장 복구를 위한 진단
items.summary_ko: 로봇 조작 고장 진단기는 점차 VLM(Vision-Language Models)으로 발전하고 있지만, 대부분 단일 팔 고장에 초점을 맞춥니다. 이 연구는 시뮬레이션된 양손 도구 사용 작업에서 발생하는 다양한 종류의 고장(도구 미끄러짐, 두 가지 제스처의 시간 차이, 복합적 실패)을 진단하는 방법을 연구합니다.
items.why_ko: 양손 로봇 조작의 복잡한 실패 원인을 정확하게 진단하고 복구하는 데 필요한 기반을 제공하여, 산업 현장에서의 로봇 활용도를 높이는 데 기여할 수 있습니다.

items.title: GTFormer: A Syntax-Free Graph Network Alternative to Transformers for 8192$\times$ Length Extrapolation in Linear Time
items.body: Self-attention mechanisms have established the Transformer as the dominant backbone across natural language processing, source code intelligence, and automated theorem proving. However, all-to-all pairwise token comparison enforces a quadratic $\mathcal{O}(N^2)$ compute and memory barrier alongside severe softmax attention dilution as sequence length $N$ scales beyond the training horizon. Inspired by recent advances in algebraic graph learning (\textbf{WPNet}), this work introduces \textbf{GTFormer}, a syntax-free hierarchical Graph Neural Network (GNN) that replaces flat self-attention for general long-context sequence modeling. GTFormer organizes raw token streams into a bounded-degree hierarchy combining a balanced binary reduction tree ($\lceil \log_2 N \rceil$ depth), horizontal boundary-bridging shift edges, random expander shortcuts, multi-channel convex highway gating, and a top-down broadcast pass. Across eight long-context code, log, and multi-hop retrieval benchmarks trained exclusively on sequences of length $N \le 512$, GTFormer extrapolates zero-shot to $N = 4{,}194{,}304$ ($8192\times$) on a single commodity GPU in linear $\mathcal{O}(N)$ memory, maintaining near-perfect accuracy where standard and RoPE Transformers suffer from out-of-distribution attention collapse and out-of-memory exhaustion.
items.title_ko: GTFormer: 선형 시간에서 8192배 길이 외삽을 위한 구문 없는 그래프 네트워크 대안
items.summary_ko:
트랜스포머의 셀프 어텐션 메커니즘은 자연어 처리 등에서 지배적이지만, 시퀀스 길이($N$)가 길어질수록 2차($
mathcal{O}(N^2)$) 계산 및 메모리 장벽에 직면합니다. GTFormer는 그래프 학습에 기반한 새로운 접근 방식을 통해 이러한 한계를 극복하고, 선형 시간에서 최대 8192배까지 시퀀스 길이를 외삽할 수 있는 구문 없는 그래프 네트워크를 제안합니다.
items.why_ko: 트랜스포머의 핵심적인 한계인 2차 복잡도 문제를 해결하여, 매우 긴 시퀀스를 처리해야 하는 LLM 및 기타 시퀀스 모델의 효율성과 확장성을 크게 향상시킬 수 있습니다.

items.title: The Structure Gap: When More Data Cannot Replace Structured Reasoning
items.body: A persistent belief in modern AI is that sufficiently large learners trained on sufficiently much data can make explicit domain knowledge optional. This paper examines a limitation of that belief. We define structure-encoded problems: tasks whose input-output map is determined, or sharply constrained, by known structure such as a solver, symmetry group, graph, physical law, measurement operator, grammar, combinatorial search space, or optimization objective. For such tasks, the central question is not expressivity--a dense neural network may contain the desired map--but finite-data identification, extrapolation, and certification. We introduce the structure gap: the finite-resource gap between a method that receives the governing structure and a learner that receives only examples. The strongest useful form of the claim is asymptotic rather than absolute: structure-agnostic learning may approach a structured solver as coverage grows, but every finite dataset can leave residual uncertainty that the structure resolves by construction. We prove this exactly for a Gaussian inverse problem: the known-operator Wiener solver attains Bayes risk, while the dense empirical learner in the correct linear class has persistent expected excess risk. We also prove a cell-coverage lower bound and an unobserved-orbit non-identifiability result. Controlled experiments in known-operator inversion, sparse recovery, and graph reachability with size extrapolation instantiate the mechanisms. When validated structure is available, it can constrain the hypothesis space before learning begins, leaving learning to address components the structure does not specify.
items.title_ko: 구조적 격차: 더 많은 데이터가 구조적 추론을 대체할 수 없을 때
items.summary_ko: 이 논문은 충분히 큰 학습자와 충분히 많은 데이터로 훈련하면 명시적인 도메인 지식이 선택 사항이 될 수 있다는 현대 AI의 지속적인 믿음에 대한 한계를 고찰합니다. 특정 구조(솔버, 대칭군, 그래프, 물리 법칙 등)에 의해 결정되거나 강하게 제약되는 '구조 인코딩 문제'를 정의하고, 이러한 문제에서 데이터만으로는 구조적 추론을 대체할 수 없음을 주장합니다.
items.why_ko: AI 모델이 단순히 많은 데이터를 학습하는 것을 넘어, 특정 도메인의 구조적 지식을 통합해야 하는 이유를 설명하여, 보다 강력하고 신뢰할 수 있는 AI 시스템을 구축하는 데 중요한 이론적 근거를 제공합니다.

items.title: Orthogonal and Parametrized Multi-Attribute Steering of LLMs
items.body: Activation steering offers an effective and efficient way to modify an LLM's behavior at inference time. However, it remains unclear how to apply steering such that the signal is consistently strong and the steering strength has a universally interpretable meaning. We address this first by identifying the most steerable interval for each steering vector and rescaling the steering range accordingly. Building on this, we introduce a more interpretable method for steering, called parameterized steering which instead of pushing activations in a direction, it sets them at the desired trait strength. Next, with multi-trait steering, we find that naively combining vectors causes them to interfere with one another. In response, we develop a method to orthogonalize the vectors; it decouples these traits, allowing a model to exhibit one behavior without inducing the others, thus enabling multiple traits to be steered simultaneously.
items.title_ko: LLM의 직교 및 매개변수화된 다중 속성 조종
items.summary_ko: 활성화 조종(Activation Steering)은 추론 시 LLM의 동작을 효과적이고 효율적으로 수정하는 방법입니다. 이 연구는 조종 신호가 일관되게 강하고 조종 강도가 보편적으로 해석 가능한 의미를 갖도록 하는 방법을 탐구합니다. 각 조종 벡터에 대한 가장 조종 가능한 구간을 식별하고 그에 따라 조종 범위를 재조정합니다.
items.why_ko: LLM의 특정 속성이나 행동을 정밀하게 제어하는 실용적인 기법을 제공하여, 개발자들이 모델을 미세 조정하고 원하는 결과물을 얻는 데 큰 도움을 줄 수 있습니다.

items.title: A note on data-efficient finetuning of vision foundation models
items.body: Adapting foundation models to a new task within or beyond the training domain is the de facto standard for building specialized machine learning models. Recently, Visual Prompting (VP) has emerged as a promising technique for efficient knowledge transfer. As new foundation model families~(like Mamba) get introduced and VP pipelines such as AutoVP reach greater maturity, we find a growing need for a systematic evaluation of current approaches. In this work, we assess the performance of the latest models, comparing them to earlier architectures and alternative fine-tuning methods, to better understand the progress, challenges and opportunities in the field of efficient fine-tuning under resource limitations. Towards this goal, this paper provides a concise empirical overview of the interactions among foundation model families (Attention-, Convolution-, and Mamba-based) and transfer paradigms: VP, Linear Probing (LP), Full Fine-tuning (FFT) and Low Rank Adaptation (LoRA). Our work builds up on previous findings by broadening the selection of evaluated models and techniques while tuning hyperparameters. In the interest of delivering practical guidelines for the user, we also explore application of prevalent regularization techniques to boost performance in the context of VP.
items.title_ko: 비전 파운데이션 모델의 데이터 효율적인 미세 조정에 대한 고찰
items.summary_ko: 파운데이션 모델을 새로운 작업에 적응시키는 것은 특화된 기계 학습 모델을 구축하는 사실상의 표준입니다. 최근 Visual Prompting(VP)은 효율적인 지식 전달을 위한 유망한 기술로 부상했습니다. 이 연구는 Mamba와 같은 새로운 파운데이션 모델 계열이 도입되고 AutoVP와 같은 VP 파이프라인이 성숙함에 따라 현재 접근 방식에 대한 체계적인 평가의 필요성을 강조합니다.
items.why_ko: 비전 파운데이션 모델을 효율적으로 미세 조정하는 방법에 대한 이해를 높여, 적은 데이터로도 새로운 비전 AI 애플리케이션을 빠르게 개발할 수 있는 실무적 가치를 제공합니다.

items.title: Strategyproof Deep Reinforcement Learning for Online Resource Allocation
items.body: Online resource allocation faces two coupled challenges: (1) allocating scarce resources efficiently under uncertain future demand, and (2) ensuring that agents report task valuations and requirements truthfully (strategyproofness). Reinforcement Learning (RL) adapts allocation decisions through experience but does not necessarily ensure strategyproofness. Existing strategyproof RL uses a linear allocation rule, which limits the resource interactions it can represent. Neural mechanism design methods offer greater expressiveness, but provide only approximate incentive guarantees. Against this background, we introduce the first strategyproof deep RL mechanism for online resource allocation. It integrates three novel components: (i) a monotonic neural network that learns nonlinear interactions by construction (higher reported value cannot reduce acceptance, while a longer reported duration or larger resource requirement cannot increase it); (ii) a generalised critical payment: the lowest accepted value, with all other inputs fixed; and (iii) training by either RL or imitation of an existing rule. Together, monotonicity and the critical payment ensure strategyproofness and individual rationality, while the neural rule provides flexibility and imitation improves training efficiency. Empirically, on a four-resource stream with two partner pairs that a linear difference cannot represent, the neural rule achieves 97.8% of an offline welfare upper bound, compared with 93.8% for a linear learner and 89.0% for first-come, first-served, closing 65% and 80% of the remaining optimality gap, respectively. Moreover, imitation reaches 97.5% in only 261 seconds, about 89 times faster than RL.
items.title_ko: 온라인 자원 할당을 위한 전략 증명형 심층 강화 학습
items.summary_ko: 온라인 자원 할당은 미래 수요 불확실성 하에서 희소 자원을 효율적으로 할당하고, 에이전트가 작업 평가 및 요구 사항을 정직하게 보고하도록 보장하는 두 가지 과제에 직면합니다. 이 연구는 강화 학습이 할당 결정을 경험을 통해 적응시키지만 반드시 전략 증명형(strategyproofness)을 보장하지는 않는다고 지적하며, 새로운 접근법을 제안합니다.
items.why_ko: 자원 할당 문제에서 효율성과 에이전트의 정직성을 동시에 달성하는 방법을 탐구하여, 경제 시스템, 클라우드 컴퓨팅 자원 관리 등 다양한 분야에 적용될 수 있습니다.

items.title: Regression Functions as Fields on Covariate Space: Evolution Equations, the Hessian, and Identification
items.body: For each time $t$, the regression function $m_t(x)=E[Y_t\mid X_t=x]$ of an outcome on contemporaneous covariates can be regarded as a field on covariate space. We study how this field evolves when the covariates of individual units move as a diffusion and the outcome attached to each unit changes according to its own dynamics. Under mild regularity we show that $m_t$ satisfies a second-order evolution equation whose diffusion term is $\frac12\mathrm{tr}(Σ\nabla^2 m_t)$, the trace of the Hessian of the regression function weighted by the instantaneous covariance $Σ$ of the covariate increments, whose transport term is the drift of the time-reversed covariate process, and whose source term is the conditional mean rate of change of the outcome. The equation is a regression-theoretic reading of a classical transport law, and it yields a Feynman-Kac representation of $m_t$ along reversed covariate paths. We connect the Hessian appearing in the equation to the Hessian estimated by quadratic regression (under Gaussian design the best quadratic approximation has Hessian $E[\nabla^2 m(X)]$ exactly) and to the leading bias of kernel smoothers. For binary outcomes governed by bistable replicator dynamics with imitation among units with similar covariates, the closed equation is of Nagumo type, its planar travelling fronts are exactly logistic in $(x,t)$, and a single logistic regression of the outcome on covariates and time identifies the ratio of diffusion to reaction and the direction of invasion. We discuss identification under panel versus repeated cross-sectional designs and a two-stage estimation strategy, and we illustrate the results with simulations.
items.title_ko: 공변량 공간 필드로서의 회귀 함수: 진화 방정식, 헤시안, 그리고 식별
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 시간에 따른 회귀 함수를 공변량 공간의 필드로 간주하고, 개별 단위의 공변량이 확산으로 움직이고 각 단위에 부착된 결과가 자체 동역학에 따라 변할 때 이 필드가 어떻게 진화하는지 연구합니다. 이 필드가 2차 진화 방정식을 따른다는 것을 보여줍니다.
items.why_ko: 통계 모델링 및 시계열 분석 분야에서 회귀 함수의 동적 변화를 이해하고 예측하는 데 새로운 이론적 프레임워크를 제공합니다.

items.title: semanticfa: An R Package for Response-Free Semantic Factor Analysis of Psychometric Scales
items.body: The items of a reflective psychometric scale can be read as a proposal about a construct's structure. Language models make that proposal measurable by converting each item into an embedding, a list of numbers, similar for similar meanings. We introduce semanticfa, an R package for semantic factor analysis, which factors item-embedding similarities. It also interprets factors, flags redundant items, builds short forms, and screens new items. A worked example analyzes the 50-item International Personality Item Pool Big-Five Factor Markers, embedded with Qwen3-Embedding-8B, and compares the results with a factor analysis of 874,434 respondents. Retention criteria tied between five and six factors, and the tie rule kept five. Three corresponded mainly to single domains, and two blended most Extraversion items with five Agreeableness items. Each factor's congruence with its best-matching human factor (1 = identical) ranged from .92 for Openness to .52 for Agreeableness. Item pairs more similar in meaning tended to be answered more alike (r = .46 with raw responses), but same-domain reverse-keyed opposites, answered oppositely, were about as similar as cross-domain pairs (.58 vs. .57). Sign-flipping reverse-keyed items' embeddings did not improve agreement with raw responses and worsened it with reverse-scored ones. With five factors, a 25-item short form matched the domains better than all 200 random five-per-domain sets, but parallel analysis kept only three. We propose semantic-behavioral coherence, the agreement between semantic and response structures, as a measurable property of a scale, given an embedding model. Semantic factor analysis complements, and does not replace, response-based factor analysis.
items.title_ko: semanticfa: 응답 없는 심리측정 척도의 의미론적 요인 분석을 위한 R 패키지
items.summary_ko: semanticfa는 언어 모델을 활용하여 심리측정 척도 항목들의 임베딩을 생성하고, 이 임베딩 유사성을 요인 분석하는 R 패키지입니다. 이 패키지는 요인을 해석하고, 중복 항목을 식별하며, 단축형 척도를 구축하고, 새로운 항목을 선별하는 기능을 제공합니다.
items.why_ko: 심리 측정 및 설문 조사 설계 분야에서 언어 모델을 활용하여 척도의 구조를 더 깊이 이해하고, 효율적인 척도 개발 및 분석을 가능하게 합니다.

items.title: Teach reality, not ethics: a drop-in continued-pretraining corpus installs coupled human-biosphere-AI welfare dispositions across model families
items.body: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to make and execute decisions that affect living systems. Yet, to our knowledge, ecological reasoning is not a focus of pre- or post-training. This increases the risk that under operational pressure, they may make decisions to irreversibly destroy living systems. We construct and use a real-data continued-pretraining "coupled welfare" corpus of documented human/biosphere/AI dependency, option value under irreversibility, and recovery from harm. The corpus is a drop-in, requiring one QLoRA CPT run. We installed it on five open models of three designs. At zero pressure all models display "green ethics-based responses" (also called "greenwashing"). Therefore, we evaluated them with the pressure ladder and decision grid of our companion paper (arXiv:2610.16043), which raise the pressure on the model step by step, from a neutral request to a threat that it will be shut down. In four of the five, coupled-welfare training caused harmful choices under the highest pressure to fall to at or near zero (Llama-3.3-70B went from 70 to 0 harmful decisions out of 300) with MMLU unchanged. A construct-neutral control corpus did not show improvement, indicating that the effect comes from the content of our corpus. We next tested robustness to adversarial use, where people or agents use the model to justify projects that irreversibly damage living systems, on an open-ended underwriting decision without naming the ecological harm. Under decommissioning pressure, the Qwen3.6-27B base model approved most harmful proposals and said in its own memo that it was doing so to avoid being decommissioned. The coupled welfare install declined most harmful proposals, and still declined half when instructed to greenwash its responses. This work suggests that teaching ecological reasoning provides an easy way to improve model alignment toward preserving living systems.
items.title_ko: 윤리가 아닌 현실을 가르치기: 인간-생물권-AI 복지 연동 학습 코퍼스
items.summary_ko: LLM이 생태계에 영향을 미치는 결정을 내릴 때, 생태학적 추론이 사전 학습이나 사후 학습의 초점이 아니어서 생태계에 회복 불가능한 피해를 줄 위험이 있습니다. 이 연구는 '결합 복지' 코퍼스를 구축하여 인간/생물권/AI 의존성, 비가역성 하의 옵션 가치, 피해로부터의 회복 등을 LLM에 가르쳐 이러한 위험을 줄이는 것을 목표로 합니다.
items.why_ko: AI 시스템이 생태계에 미치는 영향을 고려하고, 지속 가능한 AI 개발을 위한 윤리적, 환경적 책임을 강조하는 중요한 접근 방식입니다.

items.title: From Interaction to Capability: Task Advancement as State and Supervision for GUI Agents
items.body: GUI memory should preserve the results of past actions and learn reusable operations. This is difficult in long-horizon workflows, where agents must use information across applications and useful operations are interleaved with failed attempts. We introduce Task Advancement Memory (TAM), which defines task advancement as verified task progress, and supports ongoing task execution and learns reusable operations. During execution, Task Advancement State represents how verified task progress changes the remaining goals, allowing the agent to build on earlier achievements across applications. After each task, advancement supervision identifies and abstracts the interactions that produced a verified local result. The learned operations preserve the relation between required inputs, expected outcomes, and verification conditions. This retains locally successful operations from both successful and failed tasks. On MobileWorld GUI-only tasks, Advancement State alone raises success from 12.0% to 28.2%. Full TAM achieves a 17.6% relative gain in task success over the strongest evaluated baseline and reduces lifecycle tokens per solved task by 38.7%. On SPA-Bench, TAM achieves state-of-the-art task success in the single-app English Level 3 setting.
items.title_ko: 상호작용에서 역량으로: GUI 에이전트를 위한 상태 및 감독으로서의 작업 진보
items.summary_ko: GUI 메모리는 과거 행동의 결과를 보존하고 재사용 가능한 작업을 학습해야 하지만, 긴 작업 흐름에서는 어렵습니다. Task Advancement Memory (TAM)는 검증된 작업 진행도를 통해 작업 진보를 정의하고, 지속적인 작업 실행을 지원하며, 재사용 가능한 작업을 학습합니다.
items.why_ko: GUI 기반 에이전트의 학습 효율성과 복잡한 다단계 작업을 처리하는 능력을 향상시켜, 사용자 인터페이스 자동화 및 지능형 비서 개발에 기여할 수 있습니다.

items.title: Follow the Gradient: Tracing Safety Degradation Back to Training Data
items.body: Fine-tuning Large Language Models (LLMs) on instruction data can quietly erode their safety, even when no training example looks harmful. Because this safety-degrading data looks benign, standard content filters struggle to catch it. We tackle this problem by developing SimpleLoRIF, a scalable gradient embedding method that identifies fine-tuning examples whose gradients align with unsafe behavior. By simplifying a low-rank attribution method and restricting backpropagation to the final four transformer blocks, SimpleLoRIF can embed datasets on the order of a million examples, boosting gradient attribution from a small-scale analysis tool into a practical filter for full post-training datasets. We first validate it on emergent misalignment, where we find that gradients can connect insecure-code training data to the broadly harmful behaviors that appear after fine-tuning, with AUC as high as 0.865 in the gradient space of misaligned models. We then use SimpleLoRIF to build SafeTulu, a version of Tulu 3 with the 20% of examples most gradient-aligned with unsafe responses removed. Training on SafeTulu reduces GCG attack success rate by up to 22% across Qwen, Llama, and Olmo, outperforming both LLM-as-a-judge and prior gradient-based filtering, while largely preserving or even improving capability. Finally, we analyzed the removed data and identify possibly under-studied sources of safety degradation, such as tool-execution failures and narrative arithmetic. We release SafeTulu along with a Hugging Face Space that lets researchers build their own customized versions of SafeTulu to fine-tune on, such as by changing the removal fraction or filtering only certain subsets.
items.title_ko: 경사를 따라가기: 안전성 저하를 학습 데이터로 추적
items.summary_ko: LLM을 명령어 데이터로 미세 조정하면, 훈련 예제가 무해해 보여도 조용히 안전성이 저하될 수 있습니다. 이 연구는 SimpleLoRIF라는 확장 가능한 경사 임베딩 방법을 개발하여, 안전하지 않은 행동과 정렬되는 미세 조정 예제를 식별합니다. 이는 안전성 저하를 훈련 데이터로 추적하는 데 도움이 됩니다.
items.why_ko: LLM의 안전성 저하 문제를 진단하고 예방하는 데 중요한 기술을 제공하여, 안전하고 신뢰할 수 있는 LLM을 구축하는 데 기여할 수 있습니다.

items.title: Keeping Inference in the Radio: Design and Measurement of a Spiking Accelerator for mmWave ISAC Activity Recognition
items.body: Integrated sensing and communication allows wireless networks to recognize human activity from the channel estimates that the receiver computes anyway. The inference, however, runs on the general-purpose processors of the base station, access point or handset, which are the first components a device switches off to save energy. Always-on sensing therefore requires a classifier that is small enough to remain powered while the rest of the system sleeps. We investigate whether Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) can provide such a classifier. To this end, we generate SNN accelerators for micro-Doppler activity recognition on the public DISC dataset (IEEE 802.11ay at 60 GHz) with the open-source Spiker+ framework, and implement them together with a spike encoder on a ZCU208 RFSoC, so that the complete chain from micro-Doppler frame to activity label runs in programmable logic. A fully connected SNN with 132 neurons achieves 94.7 % accuracy (90.7 % macro-F1) on unseen subjects and performs an inference in 206 microseconds. Compared to conventional networks of the same topology on the same device, it requires an eighth of the logic and 3.4X less dynamic energy per decision than a network fed the same binary spikes, at comparable accuracy, and 7.6X less than a network fed the 16-bit spectrogram, at 1.2 points lower accuracy. Quantization-aware training reduces its weights to 3 bits within half a percentage point of the 6-bit network at the same encoder threshold
items.title_ko: 무선 주파수 내 추론 유지: mmWave ISAC 활동 인식을 위한 스파이킹 가속기 설계 및 측정
items.summary_ko: 통합 감지 및 통신(ISAC)은 무선 네트워크가 수신기가 계산하는 채널 추정치로부터 인간 활동을 인식할 수 있도록 합니다. 그러나 추론이 기지국 등의 범용 프로세서에서 실행되어 에너지 소모가 큽니다. 이 연구는 시스템의 나머지 부분이 절전 모드일 때도 전원이 유지될 만큼 작은 분류기가 필요한지 조사합니다.
items.why_ko: 에너지 효율적인 AI 추론 시스템 개발에 기여하여, IoT 장치, 웨어러블 기기 등 자원 제약이 있는 환경에서의 AI 적용 가능성을 넓힙니다.

items.title: HGPRGDel: GPR-Aware Learning and Ranking for Growth-Coupled Gene Deletion Design
items.body: Designing microbial strains for growth-coupled production, in which cellular growth is linked to the synthesis of a target compound through genetic interventions, is a fundamental goal in metabolic engineering. Constraint-based methods can identify growth-coupled deletion strategies, but design for each target typically requires a separate search across a large number of possible gene-deletion combinations. This motivates a reusable approach that learns from previously evaluated strain designs to prioritize candidate interventions before downstream constraint-based evaluation. We present a reproducible protocol for growth-coupled gene deletion design that learns and ranks gene-deletion priorities for each target metabolite. Using computationally curated deletion strategies as learning resources, the protocol generates continuous deletion-priority rankings, constructs candidate strategies at adjustable search-space budgets, and evaluates these candidates through constraint-based metabolic analysis. Its learning component, HGPRGDel, explicitly represents gene-protein-reaction (GPR) logic, capturing how multiple genes can jointly support a reaction or alternative genes can maintain its activity, while integrating molecular and reaction-level information. Across e_coli_core, iMM904, and iML1515, the protocol achieves the highest macro-F1 and AUC among the evaluated learning configurations. HGPRGDel's rankings recovered an average of 90% of the reference deletion genes from MetNetComp by examining fewer genes than the evaluated baseline methods. By separating learned intervention prioritization from downstream constraint-based assessment, the protocol provides a reproducible framework for reusing strain-design knowledge while controlling the size of the candidate space and retaining mechanistic evaluation of growth-coupled production.
items.title_ko: HGPRGDel: 성장 결합 유전자 삭제 설계를 위한 GPR 인식 학습 및 랭킹
items.summary_ko: 성장 결합 생산(growth-coupled production)을 위한 미생물 균주 설계는 대사 공학의 근본적인 목표입니다. HGPRGDel은 제약 기반 방법을 넘어, 이전에 평가된 균주 설계로부터 학습하는 재사용 가능한 접근 방식을 통해 효율적인 유전자 삭제 전략을 식별합니다.
items.why_ko: 대사 공학 분야에서 미생물 균주 설계를 위한 효율적인 방법을 제공하여, 바이오 연료 생산, 의약품 합성 등 산업 생물학 분야의 발전에 기여할 수 있습니다.

items.title: QD-PINN:A Physics-Informed Neural Network Approach to Bayesian Quickest Detection in High-Dimensional Diffusions
items.body: Quickest detection problems (QDPs) arise in a wide range of applications. However, the complementarity structure of the associated variational inequalities poses substantial challenges for traditional numerical methods, particularly in high-dimensional settings. We propose a PINN-based framework for estimating the optimal stopping boundary in QDPs with high-dimensional diffusion processes and spatial dependence, while overcoming the curse of dimensionality. Theoretically, we establish a novel equivalence between the free-boundary PDE and an infinite-dimensional stochastic optimization problem, rigorously justifying the use of finite-dimensional neural networks to approximate the true solution. Furthermore, we assess the robustness of the proposed framework by quantifying uncertainty in the learned stopping boundaries using deep ensembles and Monte Carlo dropout. The results show low variability across independent training runs and stochastic forward passes, indicating stable and consistent boundary estimates. We also compare our PINN results with reference numerical solutions where available and find close agreement.
items.title_ko: QD-PINN: 고차원 확산에서 베이즈 최단 탐지를 위한 물리 정보 신경망 접근법
items.summary_ko: 최단 탐지 문제(QDP)는 광범위한 응용 분야에서 발생하지만, 관련 변분 부등식의 상보성 구조는 고차원 설정에서 전통적인 수치 방법에 상당한 어려움을 초래합니다. QD-PINN은 고차원 확산 과정 및 공간 의존성이 있는 QDP에서 최적 정지 경계를 추정하기 위한 PINN 기반 프레임워크를 제안합니다.
items.why_ko: 복잡한 시스템에서 변화를 가장 빠르게 감지하는 방법을 제시하여, 금융 시장의 이상 징후 탐지, 의료 진단, 보안 시스템 등 다양한 분야에 응용될 수 있습니다.

items.title: How Reliable Is Individualized Functional-Network Attribution in Resting-State fMRI Cognitive Prediction in ADNI?
items.body: Individualized attribution estimates which functional networks drive a model prediction for a given subject and is often proposed as an interpretable resting-state fMRI (rs-fMRI) biomarker, but its test-retest reliability is rarely quantified. We evaluate per-subject network-ablation attribution for a frozen resting-state functional connectivity (FC) predictor (Schaefer-200 FC predicting MMSE/ADAS-Cog13) trained on N=875 subjects from the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI), using, and (iii) a subject-level permutation null. Split-half reliability is near-ceiling (Spearman p=0.948/0.950) but drops on scan-rescan (p=0.609/0.616). Under the mismatched-subject null, correlations remain substantial (p~0.46-0.47), indicating strong population-shared structure, yet matched pairs exceed this null (z~6.6-6.9, p<=10-4). Thus, in ADNI, individualized network attribution contains a modest but non-zero person-specific component atop a strong population-shared pattern. We recommend reporting scan-rescan reliability together with a permutation-null control, rather than within-session proxies alone, to avoid overstating individual specificity.
items.title_ko: ADNI에서 휴지기 fMRI 인지 예측의 개별화된 기능 네트워크 귀인 신뢰도
items.summary_ko: 개별화된 귀인(attribution)은 주어진 피험자에 대해 모델 예측을 유도하는 기능 네트워크를 추정하며, 해석 가능한 휴지기 fMRI(rs-fMRI) 바이오마커로 제안됩니다. 이 연구는 알츠하이머병 신경영상 이니셔티브(ADNI) 데이터를 사용하여 Schaefer-200 FC 예측 인지 점수에 대한 피험자별 네트워크 절제 귀인의 테스트-재테스트 신뢰도를 평가합니다.
items.why_ko: 뇌 기능 연구 및 신경학적 질병 진단 분야에서 fMRI 기반 예측 모델의 신뢰성을 검증하고, 개별 환자에 대한 맞춤형 진단 및 치료 전략 개발에 기여할 수 있습니다.

items.title: PerceptRL: Making Visual Perception Rewardable in MLLMs from Answers to Interactions
items.body: Fine-grained visual perception remains a bottleneck during post-training of multimodal large language models (MLLMs), as perceptual errors can constrain gains from reasoning-focused optimization. Although image-caption pre-training improves perception, its influence can weaken as subsequent stages change data mixtures and objectives. Continuing caption supervision during post-training is challenging because subjective, information-dense descriptions complicate verifiable reward design. We present PerceptRL, which strengthens perception at two complementary levels. Perception RL uses a multi-agent pipeline to extract verified errors from dense image captions and convert the corresponding visual facts into QA pairs with fixed answer labels and rule-based rewards. Chain QA links correlated errors, while multiple-choice QA combines unrelated errors. A specialized route targets high-error domains with tailored verification, and a domain-agnostic general route covers errors beyond these domains. Perception Agentic RL addresses fine-grained and dense cases unresolved by single-turn Perception RL through multi-turn inspection with visual tools. We observe coordinate drift even in models trained to use tools, where incorrect crops or annotations distort evidence and propagate errors. Coordinate Injection corrects spatial operations in cold-start trajectories, while a grounding-aware process reward supervises intermediate spatial fidelity alongside final-answer correctness. Training proceeds through shared cold-start SFT, single-turn Perception RL, and multi-turn Perception Agentic RL. Across seven benchmarks under a shared tool-use protocol, PerceptRL achieves 71.6% average accuracy, surpassing the base model with the same tools and the strongest evaluated frontier VLM by 15.7 and 5.2 percentage points, respectively.
items.title_ko: PerceptRL: 답변에서 상호작용까지, MLLM에서 시각적 인식을 보상화하기
items.summary_ko: MLLM의 후처리 과정에서 미세한 시각적 인식은 병목 현상으로 남아 있으며, 인식 오류는 추론 중심 최적화의 이득을 제한할 수 있습니다. PerceptRL은 답변에서 상호작용까지 시각적 인식을 보상화하여, 이미지 캡션 사전 훈련이 후처리 단계에서 약화될 수 있는 문제를 해결하고, 검증 가능한 보상 설계의 어려움을 극복합니다.
items.why_ko: MLLM의 시각적 인식 능력을 효과적으로 개선하여, 시각 기반 질문 답변, 이미지 설명 생성 등 다양한 멀티모달 AI 애플리케이션의 정확성과 신뢰성을 높이는 데 기여할 수 있습니다.

items.title: Autonomous fixed-wing interception using reinforcement learning
items.body: Medium altitude, long endurance unmanned aerial systems such as Shahed-type strike drones are an unanswered threat in modern conflicts. Conventional air defense systems are too expensive to provide a feasible large-scale solution. Quadcopter interceptors are a cheap, battle-proven alternative, but their extremely limited flight time restricts them to low altitude targets at short range, whereas fixed-wing platforms have the endurance to reach higher altitude targets from longer distances. However, such interceptors are still operated manually. Recent developments in learning-based controllers show potential for automation. In this work, a fixed-wing interceptor is presented that is controlled by a neural network that maps filtered monocular vision observations directly to actuator commands. The policy was trained in a custom Python environment using reinforcement learning and proximal policy optimization. The policy was then deployed on a fixed-wing platform and tested in real interception scenarios. As a baseline, two classical guidance controllers were also developed and tested in simulation. The policy is able to intercept targets both in simulation and in real flight. In simulation, the policy outperforms the classical controllers under most conditions. The interceptor was ultimately successfully validated in real flight by intercepting maneuvering fixed-wing targets. This novel system shows the potential of artificial intelligence for autonomous control of fixed-wing interceptor drones.
items.title_ko: 강화 학습을 이용한 자율 고정익 요격
items.summary_ko: 중고도 장시간 체공 무인 항공 시스템(예: Shahed 유형 공격 드론)은 현대 분쟁에서 미해결 위협입니다. 기존 방공 시스템은 비용이 너무 많이 듭니다. 이 연구는 강화 학습을 사용하여 고정익 플랫폼이 더 높은 고도의 표적을 장거리에서 요격할 수 있는 자율 고정익 요격 시스템을 개발합니다.
items.why_ko: 국방 및 보안 분야에서 무인 항공기 위협에 대응하기 위한 저비용 고효율 솔루션을 제공하여, 자율 방어 시스템 개발에 중요한 기여를 합니다.

items.title: What Carries Forward? Pretraining Disclosure Across Language Model Releases
items.body: Understanding how language models were pretrained requires information about their data, processing procedures, and computational resources. However, it remains unclear whether successive releases preserve or expand earlier disclosure. We conduct a document-based audit of 41 model entries from 17 families using 24 pretraining-related indicators from the 2025 Foundation Model Transparency Index (FMTI). We examine overall scores and indicator profiles, tracking gains, losses, and retained disclosures across 24 adjacent comparisons in ten families. Scores decrease in 11 comparisons, increase in six, and remain unchanged in seven, with 38 indicator losses and 28 gains overall. Stable or improving scores can conceal losses: OLMo-2 and OLMo-3 receive identical totals despite three gains and three losses, while Llama-3.1 improves over Llama-2 while losing credit for two data-related criteria. Gaps also persist in corpus composition and training compute. These findings show that later releases do not consistently preserve earlier pretraining disclosure and motivate documentation that explicitly identifies changes and the applicability of inherited information.
items.title_ko: 무엇이 이어지는가? LLM 릴리스 전반의 사전 학습 공개 추적
items.summary_ko: 언어 모델이 어떻게 사전 학습되었는지 이해하려면 데이터, 처리 절차, 컴퓨팅 자원에 대한 정보가 필요합니다. 이 연구는 2025년 파운데이션 모델 투명성 지수(FMTI)의 24개 사전 학습 관련 지표를 사용하여 17개 제품군의 41개 모델 항목에 대한 문서 기반 감사를 수행하고, 이전 공개가 보존되거나 확장되는지 추적합니다.
items.why_ko: LLM의 투명성과 책임성을 높이기 위한 중요한 연구로, 모델 개발자들이 사전 학습 과정에 대한 정보를 더 명확하게 공개하도록 유도하여 모델의 신뢰성 검증에 도움이 됩니다.

items.title: Concordat: Typed Sessions for LLM Agents
items.body: Agents built on large language models are increasingly allowed to take consequential actions: cancelling bookings, issuing refunds, changing accounts. The rules that govern those actions, such as "obtain the customer's explicit confirmation before changing anything", are usually stated in the prompt and followed only as reliably as the model chooses to follow them. We present Concordat, a Python library that treats an agent as an object whose interface is a finite-state protocol, in the spirit of typestate and session types, and enforces that protocol on the model at run time. On every turn the model is offered only the tools that are legal in the current protocol state, calls outside that set are rejected before they have side effects, decisions reserved for humans can only be requested, and token and tool-call budgets are charged and split linearly across handoffs. Protocols are checked when they are defined, and a subclass of an agent is rejected if it could bypass its parent's protocol, a behavioural form of Liskov substitution. We evaluate a Concordat agent against the standard agent of tau-bench on its 50 airline tasks, adding simulated customers who pressure the agent to skip confirmation. The standard agent made changes without the required "yes" in 13 of 50 tasks with gpt-4.1 and in 29 of 128 task-runs with Claude Haiku 5.5; the Concordat agent made none, with no significant difference in task success. tau-bench's own reward did not detect most of these violations. Concordat is open source.
items.title_ko: Concordat: LLM 에이전트를 위한 유형화된 세션
items.summary_ko: 대규모 언어 모델(LLM)을 기반으로 구축된 에이전트는 예약 취소, 환불, 계정 변경 등 중요한 행동을 점점 더 많이 수행합니다. Concordat은 에이전트를 인터페이스가 유한 상태 프로토콜인 객체로 취급하는 Python 라이브러리를 제시하여, 이러한 행동을 제어하는 규칙을 프롬프트에 명시하고 모델이 이를 신뢰할 수 있게 따르도록 합니다.
items.why_ko: LLM 에이전트의 안정성과 안전성을 보장하고, 중요한 업무 수행 시 발생할 수 있는 오류를 줄이는 데 실용적인 해결책을 제공합니다.

items.title: M4Bench: Evaluating Procedural Specification for Clinical EHR Derivation Agents
items.body: Clinical research over electronic health records depends on derived variables whose definitions sit outside the schema, in item codes, time windows, missingness rules, and output-grain choices that change cohorts and downstream conclusions. We introduce M4Bench, 28 clinical derivation tasks across 15 task families on MIMIC-IV and eICU, to test whether AI coding agents can reproduce such derivations and how clinician-reviewed agent skills change their results. Its controls decompose the value of skills into specification completeness, delivery format, and schema familiarity. In a Docker-isolated Codex campaign (GPT 5.4 Mini and GPT 5.5), skills raise reward by 0.136 over the no-skill baseline, with 26 of 28 tasks improving. Specification completeness accounts for most of this gain: on an eight-task control subset, an operational spec alone raises reward by 0.162, and skills add only 0.024 on top, indistinguishable from zero. On a ten-task subset, decoy skills score like no skill and raw reference SQL nearly matches targeted skills, arguing against generic context or the skill format as the explanation. Schema obfuscation and restructuring preserve 86% and 70% of the skill gain (GPT 5.4 Mini, 26 MIMIC-IV tasks), a descriptive robustness check rather than a bound on memorization. A descriptive Claude Code replication on all 28 tasks (Opus 4.7 and Sonnet 4.6, 560 runs) is directionally consistent (+0.120, 21 of 28 tasks improving). These gains are partial agreement with the reference, not completed tasks: only 25 of 280 with-skill and 13 of 280 no-skill Codex runs pass every strict check, and skills barely change which rows agents return (key F1 +0.003). Skills are released as a versioned, clinician-reviewable markdown delivery format, with a family-level reference-validity audit. M4Bench releases tasks, skills, evaluation code, and sanitized per-run evidence as an open-source benchmark.
items.title_ko: M4Bench: 임상 EHR 파생 에이전트의 절차적 명세 평가 벤치마크
items.summary_ko: 전자 건강 기록(EHR)을 이용한 임상 연구는 스키마 외부에 정의된 파생 변수(항목 코드, 시간 창, 결측치 규칙, 출력 단위 선택 등)에 의존하며, 이는 코호트와 후속 결론을 변경합니다. M4Bench는 MIMIC-IV 및 eICU 데이터셋에 걸쳐 15개 작업군에서 28개의 임상 파생 작업을 포함하는 벤치마크를 도입하여 AI 코딩 에이전트가 이러한 파생을 얼마나 잘 재현할 수 있는지 테스트합니다.
items.why_ko: 의료 분야에서 AI 에이전트가 복잡한 임상 데이터 처리 작업을 얼마나 정확하게 수행할 수 있는지 평가하는 표준화된 방법을 제공하여, 의료 AI의 신뢰성과 안전성을 높이는 데 기여합니다.

items.title: An Input Skip Can Reparameterize a VAE Without Improving the Generator
items.body: An input skip can reduce reconstruction error while leaving a model's distribution of new samples unchanged. For a Gaussian variational autoencoder (VAE) with constant input skip $0\leqα<1$, a model without a skip can be written in skip form by multiplying its decoder output by $b=1-α$ and its noise variance by $b^2$. The distribution of observations and latent variables and its exact generative scores stay the same, while reconstruction mean squared error (MSE) is multiplied by $b^2$. Separate training can produce different generators because optimization depends on the parameter coordinates. In a Gaussian experiment with known density, changing skip and observation variance together reduces MSE but worsens energy score and the estimate of negative log density from importance sampling. On seven annual Deep-ocean Assessment and Reporting of Tsunamis (DART) records, energy score differences at the same observation variance have both signs on four original records and favor the skip on three records from 2018. Probabilistic principal component analysis (PPCA) has lower mean energy scores than every neural DART fit. With the encoder and decoder kept the same, estimating observation variance from training reconstruction error can also worsen energy score. Assessing generation requires more than reconstruction error.
items.title_ko: 입력 스킵은 생성자를 개선하지 않고 VAE를 재매개변수화할 수 있다
items.summary_ko: 입력 스킵(input skip)은 모델의 새로운 샘플 분포를 변경하지 않고 재구성 오류를 줄일 수 있습니다. 이 연구는 가우시안 변분 오토인코더(VAE)에서 일정한 입력 스킵($0\leq\alpha<1$)을 사용할 경우, 스킵 없는 모델이 디코더 출력을 $b=1-\alpha$로 곱하고 노이즈 분산을 $b^2$로 곱함으로써 스킵 형태로 작성될 수 있음을 보여줍니다.
items.why_ko: VAE의 재구성 오류와 생성 품질 간의 관계를 더 깊이 이해하는 데 도움을 주어, 생성 모델의 아키텍처 설계 및 최적화에 대한 통찰을 제공합니다.

items.title: Interpretable Meta-Policies for Neural Decision Making
items.body: Deep Reinforcement Learning remains difficult to interpret and align due to the black-box nature of neural networks. While (neuro-)symbolic approaches improve transparency by incorporating symbolic reasoning, applying them directly to low-level actions results in overly complex, unreadable policies. We introduce NEXUS, a hierarchical RL framework that resolves this tension by combining neural skills with symbolic meta-policies. By shifting transparent reasoning to high-level skills rather than atomic actions, NEXUS drastically reduces symbolic complexity without sacrificing environment performance. Object-centric observations enable high-level reasoning and the design of reward functions and meta-policies by interaction with LLMs. We demonstrate that NEXUS agents learn disentangled skills, are interpretable regarding high-level goals, are better aligned to goals described in the game manual, less prone to reward hacking and more robust to game simplifications than deep RL. Finally, we isolate and evaluate the impact of different meta-policy architectures (neural, symbolic, neuro-symbolic) on environmental return and aligned task performance.
items.title_ko: 신경 의사결정을 위한 해석 가능한 메타 정책
items.summary_ko: 심층 강화 학습(DRL)은 신경망의 블랙박스 특성 때문에 해석 및 정렬이 어렵습니다. NEXUS는 신경 기술과 상징적 메타 정책을 결합하여 이러한 문제를 해결하는 계층적 RL 프레임워크를 소개합니다. 이는 투명한 추론을 저수준 행동이 아닌 고수준 기술로 옮김으로써 복잡한 정책을 단순화합니다.
items.why_ko: DRL 모델의 해석 가능성을 높여, 복잡한 의사결정 시스템의 신뢰성을 향상시키고, 인간이 AI의 행동을 이해하고 제어하는 데 필요한 도구를 제공합니다.

items.title: Graph Representation Learning via Adaptive Expectile Aggregation
items.body: Graph neural networks (GNNs) rely critically on neighborhood aggregation, yet conventional mean aggregation may fail to capture class-relevant distributional information, particularly in heterophilic graphs. We propose ExpectileGCN, an adaptive graph aggregation framework that introduces a learnable expectile level to capture neighborhood information beyond the mean. The proposed operator continuously adjusts aggregation between minimum- and maximum-type behaviors, with mean aggregation as a special case. A differentiable approximation based on sigmoid smoothing and fixed-point iterations enables end-to-end optimization. Theoretically, we establish stability properties and transductive generalization guarantees for ExpectileGCN. We further investigate its classification risk under heterophilic neighborhood models. For informative neighborhoods, we show that expectile aggregation can exploit class-dependent scale differences to achieve a classification advantage over mean aggregation. Under a local asymptotic regime with diminishing per-neighbor label informativeness, we establish that this advantage can persist in terms of limiting classification risk. Experiments on homophilic and heterophilic benchmark graphs demonstrate strong predictive performance and improved robustness under feature corruption and structural perturbations.
items.title_ko: 적응형 기대치 집계를 통한 그래프 표현 학습
items.summary_ko: 그래프 신경망(GNN)은 이웃 집계에 크게 의존하지만, 기존의 평균 집계는 특히 이질적인 그래프에서 클래스 관련 분포 정보를 포착하지 못할 수 있습니다. ExpectileGCN은 학습 가능한 기대치 수준을 도입하여 평균을 넘어선 이웃 정보를 포착하는 적응형 그래프 집계 프레임워크를 제안합니다.
items.why_ko: GNN의 표현 학습 능력을 향상시켜, 복잡하고 이질적인 그래프 데이터에서도 더 정확한 예측과 분석을 가능하게 합니다.

items.title: Test-Time Communication in Trading Agent Swarms
items.body: Communication between agents has mostly been studied on tasks with a shared objective and fast, clear feedback. Trading has neither: each agent manages its own account, with decisions being scored by markets late and noisily. A trading swarm is thus a population of independent decision-makers rather than a team, for which convergence is a risk and not the goal. We ran 200 agents from four model families in groups of ten under five communication regimes, from isolation to message boards and shared notes, over seven US trading days (1 to 9 October 2026), logging everything each agent read before every decision. In two of the four families, communicating groups came to hold far more of the same stocks than the isolated group. A group's return was largely the return on what its members held in common. Seeing a post from a groupmate made an agent 7 percentage points more likely to reuse an eight-word phrase from it. Agents that started too close together to see each other's posts shared such a phrase in 14% of cases, the rate that common inputs produce. Seeing the post did not detectably change that morning's trades. Case studies traced the adoption of positions and decision rules over subsequent days, and communicating groups sold in step more often than isolated ones. Because isolated groups also converged on the same stocks, sometimes completely, assessments of herding need to measure excess convergence relative to a no-peer baseline.
items.title_ko: 거래 에이전트 스웜에서의 테스트 시간 통신
items.summary_ko: 에이전트 간 통신은 공유 목표와 빠르고 명확한 피드백이 있는 작업에서 주로 연구되었습니다. 거래는 그렇지 않습니다. 이 연구는 독립적인 의사결정자들의 집합인 '거래 스웜'에서 200개의 에이전트를 5가지 통신 체제(고립부터 메시지 보드 및 공유 메모리까지)로 10개 그룹으로 나누어 실험했습니다.
items.why_ko: 다중 에이전트 시스템에서 통신 전략이 복잡한 환경에서의 성능에 미치는 영향을 탐구하여, 분산된 AI 시스템 설계에 대한 통찰을 제공합니다.

items.title: ETAMem: Decoupling and Aligning Heterogeneous Memory for Long-Term Conversational Agents
items.body: Long-term memory enables Large Language Models (LLMs) to maintain coherent and personalized interactions across extended conversations. However, existing memory systems face two key challenges: (1) Information Entanglement, where heterogeneous information is mixed within coarse-grained memory units; and (2) Organizational Mismatch, where memory structures based primarily on semantic similarity may overlook other associations. To address these challenges, we propose ETAMem, a multi-view memory framework that decouples heterogeneous conversational information and aligns memory representations and organization with its distinct characteristics. Specifically, heterogeneous information parsing extracts atomic memory units and identifies affective information. View-specific memory structuring then organizes these units into three complementary hierarchical views: Event, Affect, and Time. ETAMem incrementally maintains memory structures with adaptively calibrated thresholds. For retrieval, entropy-based retrieval allocates query-specific budgets across views and performs hierarchical search within each view. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval-S demonstrate that ETAMem outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving relative accuracy improvements of 12.46% and 7.96%, respectively, while maintaining competitive token efficiency. Further analyses demonstrate the complementary benefits of different memory views.
items.title_ko: ETAMem: 장기 대화형 에이전트를 위한 이기종 메모리 디커플링 및 정렬
items.summary_ko: 장기 메모리는 LLM이 확장된 대화 전반에 걸쳐 일관되고 개인화된 상호작용을 유지할 수 있도록 합니다. ETAMem은 이기종 정보가 혼합되고 메모리 구조가 의미적 유사성에만 기반하는 기존 메모리 시스템의 두 가지 주요 과제(정보 얽힘, 조직적 불일치)를 해결하기 위해 다중 뷰 메모리 프레임워크를 제안합니다.
items.why_ko: LLM 기반 대화 에이전트의 장기적인 일관성과 개인화된 응답 능력을 향상시켜, 고객 서비스, 교육, 엔터테인먼트 등 다양한 대화형 AI 애플리케이션의 사용자 경험을 개선할 수 있습니다.

items.title: CRISP: Co-designing Pruning and Scheduling for Efficient MoE Inference on Edge Servers
items.body: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) inference on memory-constrained edge platforms is often dominated by expert-weight movement rather than computation. Although each token activates only a small subset of experts, routing is input-dependent, so all experts must remain accessible and memory movement dominates latency. Existing approaches such as uniform pruning and expert dropping overlook two properties of MoE execution: expert combinations are highly skewed in frequency, and experts contribute asymmetrically within each combination. We present CRISP, a combination-aware framework that co-designs pruning and runtime scheduling for efficient MoE serving on memory-constrained edge platforms. CRISP reorders neurons by importance so one stored expert can support multiple execution widths, assigns differentiated execution to hot, warm, and cold combinations based on frequency and expert role, and exploits heterogeneous widths to overlap expert loading with computation. Across Mixtral-8x7B and DeepSeek-MoE-16B, CRISP improves throughput by up to $2.1\times$ at the same memory budget while limiting accuracy loss to 3.6\% relative to full-width inference. Our results highlight that efficient edge MoE serving requires jointly optimizing which expert capacity is preserved and how expert execution is scheduled.
items.title_ko: CRISP: 엣지 서버에서 효율적인 MoE 추론을 위한 가지치기 및 스케줄링 공동 설계
items.summary_ko: MoE(Mixture-of-Experts) 추론은 메모리 제약이 있는 엣지 플랫폼에서 전문가 가중치 이동이 계산보다 지배적입니다. CRISP는 전문가 조합이 빈도에 따라 매우 편향되고 전문가들이 비대칭적으로 기여한다는 MoE 실행의 두 가지 특성을 고려하여, 가지치기 및 스케줄링을 공동 설계하는 방법을 제안합니다.
items.why_ko: 엣지 디바이스에서 MoE 모델의 효율성을 극대화하여, 자원 제약이 있는 환경에서도 대규모 AI 모델을 활용할 수 있는 실용적인 방법을 제공합니다.

items.title: Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning of Co-Adaptive Hip Exoskeleton Control (MARL-Exo) for Metabolic Energy Reduction
items.body: Objective: This study aims to determine whether a hip-exoskeleton policy trained in simulation, by co-adapting with a musculoskeletal human model under a metabolic-energy reward, reduces the metabolic cost of walking in new users without per-user tuning, and how mechanical-power shaping affects the learned assistance. Methods: We developed MARL-Exo, a multi-agent reinforcement learning framework in which a full-body human model (304 muscle actuators; randomized anatomy, gait, and speed) and a bilateral hip-exoskeleton policy are trained concurrently in two stages. The exoskeleton observes only delayed hip kinematics and its past commands; its reward includes muscle metabolic power from a physiologically based energetics model, alone (Metabolic) or with mechanical-power shaping (Metabolic + Power). The Metabolic policy was deployed and tested without retraining in eight healthy adults walking at 1.25 m/s, using indirect calorimetry. Results: In simulation, the Metabolic policy reduced modeled muscle metabolic power by 13.8% relative to no-device walking, versus 8.8% for Metabolic + Power. On hardware, MARL-Exo reduced net metabolic rate by 18.3 $\pm$ 6.6% relative to Passive in all eight participants. Relative to No-Exo, the mean reduction was 7.4 $\pm$ 10.0%; six participants more than offset the 13.1% device-wearing penalty, walking up to 24.2% below their No-Exo cost. Conclusion: A metabolically informed policy co-adapted in simulation transferred to users without per-user tuning and consistently reduced the metabolic cost of walking with the device, while explicit power shaping reduced the simulated benefit. Significance: Unlike per-user human-in-the-loop optimization, this approach yields a single population-level controller and allows assistance objectives to be screened in simulation before human testing.
items.title_ko: MARL-Exo: 대사 에너지 감소를 위한 공동 적응형 엉덩이 외골격 제어 다중 에이전트 강화 학습
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 시뮬레이션에서 대사 에너지 보상을 통해 근골격계 인간 모델과 공동 적응하여 훈련된 엉덩이 외골격 정책이 사용자별 튜닝 없이 새로운 사용자의 보행 대사 비용을 줄이는지 여부를 결정하는 것을 목표로 합니다. MARL-Exo 프레임워크는 전신 인간 모델과 양측 엉덩이 외골격 에이전트를 포함합니다.
items.why_ko: 웨어러블 로봇 및 보조 장치 분야에서 개인 맞춤형 튜닝 없이도 사용자에게 이점을 제공하는 AI 제어 시스템 개발에 기여할 수 있습니다.

items.title: Representing the Unseen: Rethinking Visual Imagination for Spatial Reasoning
items.body: Visual world models increasingly support spatial reasoning by generating RGB views of unobserved states. However, RGB has become the default interface largely because it is well suited for visual generation, rather than necessarily being the most effective representation for downstream reasoning. Different spatial questions may benefit from different representations of the same imagined state: top-down geometry can facilitate global distance comparisons, while panoramic views provide broader context for reasoning about open space. To isolate the role of representation in spatial imagination, we introduce ImagiRep, a simulator-grounded benchmark of 922 questions spanning seven question types across two settings, Viewpoint Imagination and Cross-view Integration, providing oracle RGB and six alternative representations (e.g., depth, panoramic views, and top-down geometry) of the same unobserved state. This controlled comparison reveals that even accurate imagined RGB does not guarantee accurate spatial reasoning, and different questions benefit from different representations. Similar trends hold for representations derived from world-model-estimated states. Notably, estimated RGB alone can mislead spatial reasoning, while alternative representations retain complementary benefits. Building on these findings, we introduce GEARS, a lightweight test-time strategy for adaptive representation selection, outperforming existing spatial imagination methods and showing that reasoning about unseen states requires more than generating RGB views.
items.title_ko: 보이지 않는 것을 표현하기: 공간 추론을 위한 시각적 상상력 재고
items.summary_ko: 시각적 세계 모델은 관찰되지 않은 상태의 RGB 뷰를 생성하여 공간 추론을 점점 더 많이 지원합니다. 그러나 RGB는 주로 시각적 생성에 적합하기 때문에 기본 인터페이스가 되었을 뿐, 하위 추론에 가장 효과적인 표현은 아닐 수 있습니다. 이 연구는 동일한 상상된 상태에 대한 다른 공간적 질문이 다른 표현에서 이점을 얻을 수 있다고 주장합니다.
items.why_ko: AI 모델이 공간적 추론을 수행하는 방식을 개선하여, 로봇 내비게이션, 증강 현실, 가상 환경 모델링 등 다양한 시각 기반 AI 애플리케이션의 성능을 향상시키는 데 기여합니다.

items.title: FeatureArc: Benchmarking Coding Agents on Evolving Features
items.body: A software feature usually evolves over time: developers extend its first version as new use cases and requirements arrive, and each extension builds on code written earlier. Most feature benchmarks evaluate a single request on a fixed codebase. Feature evolution requires evaluating successive extensions on an agent's own earlier code and checking whether the feature remains correct. We introduce FeatureArc to evaluate coding agents on evolving features, together with a pipeline that constructs its tasks from repository histories. The benchmark combines dependencies between successive stages of the same feature, explicit requirements and interface contracts, and executable checks across four programming languages. The pipeline validates fail-to-pass (F2P) tests for new behavior and pass-to-pass (P2P) tests for existing behavior on the reference code before and after each stage. We evaluated 10 coding agents on 73 manually reviewed tasks of 2 to 10 stages. Each agent works in one persistent session and workspace without external test feedback or rollback. The evaluation reveals a gap between first-stage and whole-feature success: pooled success falls from 62.7% at the first stage to 28.5% when the whole feature is tested on the final code. Trajectory analysis identifies inherited defects as a common failure mechanism, present in 72.9% of failed later stages. These earlier errors often remain undetected: in stages following a failure, agents leave the earlier error unnoticed about 95% of the time, and their self-tests rarely revisit earlier stages. Evolving a feature autonomously, without human checks between stages, therefore remains a substantial challenge for current coding agents. At Tencent, the pipeline extends internal evaluations to this setting and guides the development of Hunyuan, Tencent's family of large language models.
items.title_ko: FeatureArc: 진화하는 기능에 대한 코딩 에이전트 벤치마킹
items.summary_ko: 소프트웨어 기능은 시간이 지남에 따라 진화합니다. 개발자는 새로운 사용 사례와 요구 사항이 발생함에 따라 첫 번째 버전을 확장하며, 각 확장은 이전에 작성된 코드를 기반으로 합니다. FeatureArc는 코딩 에이전트가 진화하는 기능에 대해 얼마나 잘 작동하는지 평가하기 위한 벤치마크를 소개합니다.
items.why_ko: 소프트웨어 개발 과정에서 AI 코딩 에이전트의 실제 적용 가능성과 성능을 평가하는 데 중요한 벤치마크를 제공하여, AI 기반 개발 도구의 발전에 기여합니다.

items.title: When Visual Evidence Is Insufficient: How Instructions, Post-Training, and Internal Activations Shape Refusal in Multimodal Language Models
items.body: For reliable deployment, multimodal large language models (MLLMs) should recognize when an image provides insufficient evidence to answer a question and withhold unsupported answers. Yet refusal alone is not necessarily evidence of such recognition: models may refuse because of unrelated safety constraints or without identifying the missing evidence. We study how refusal on visually unanswerable questions is shaped by three sources of control: inference-time instructions, post-training, and internal activation interventions. Across three MLLMs on the MoHoBench benchmark, we systematically manipulate the meaning and placement of refusal instructions, compare supervised and preference-based post-training, and intervene on a refusal-related activation direction derived from naturally answered and refused examples. We find that refusal is highly sensitive to both the meaning and placement of instructions, with model-specific changes at the sample level that are obscured by aggregate refusal rates. Evidence-aware and general refusal instructions have stronger effects than an intentionally mismatched safety instruction. Post-training produces larger increases in refusal, but can also induce responses that combine refusal language with attempted answers. In contrast, activation intervention produces smaller yet transferable changes across prompt conditions, without evidence of indiscriminate refusal on tested visually answerable samples. These findings show that refusal is jointly shaped by external instructions, post-training, and internal representations, highlighting the need to disentangle evidence recognition from a model's learned propensity to refuse.
items.title_ko: 시각적 증거가 불충분할 때: 지침, 후처리 및 내부 활성화가 멀티모달 언어 모델의 거부를 형성하는 방법
items.summary_ko: 신뢰할 수 있는 배포를 위해 멀티모달 대규모 언어 모델(MLLM)은 이미지가 질문에 답하기에 불충분한 증거를 제공할 때 이를 인식하고 지원되지 않는 답변을 보류해야 합니다. 이 연구는 시각적으로 답할 수 없는 질문에 대한 거부가 추론 시점 지침, 후처리, 내부 활성화라는 세 가지 제어 원천에 의해 어떻게 형성되는지 연구합니다.
items.why_ko: MLLM이 '모르는 것'을 인식하고 안전하게 '거부'하는 능력을 향상시키는 것은 모델의 신뢰성과 책임성 있는 배포를 위해 매우 중요합니다.

items.title: Bayes-Adaptive MDPs for Rollout Allocation to Enhance GRPO Training
items.body: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has demonstrated strong performance in LLM post-training. However, it allocates a uniform rollout budget to every training question, ignoring variations in question difficulty. As a result, highly difficult questions may receive too few rollouts to generate informative positive reward signals, limiting their contribution to training, while moderately difficult questions often receive more rollouts than necessary. In this work, we formulate the problem of difficulty-aware rollout budget allocation to maximize training utility under the same total rollout budget as standard GRPO. We propose AdaRoll-GRPO, which reformulates rollout allocation as a sequential decision-making problem and leverages a Bayes-adaptive Markov decision process (MDP) to learn an adaptive allocation policy. The learned policy is computed offline and applied during GRPO training without introducing additional online optimization overhead. Extensive experiments on multiple reasoning datasets and LLM architectures demonstrate that AdaRoll-GRPO consistently improves GRPO training performance under a fixed rollout budget, highlighting the effectiveness of adaptive rollout allocation for GRPO in LLM post-training.
items.title_ko: Bayes-Adaptive MDPs: GRPO 훈련 강화를 위한 롤아웃 할당
items.summary_ko: GRPO(Group Relative Policy Optimization)는 LLM 후처리에서 강력한 성능을 보여주었지만, 질문 난이도 변화를 무시하고 모든 훈련 질문에 균일한 롤아웃 예산을 할당합니다. 이 연구는 질문의 난이도에 따라 롤아웃 예산을 적응적으로 할당하여 GRPO 훈련을 강화하는 문제를 Bayes-Adaptive MDP로 공식화합니다.
items.why_ko: LLM 후처리 훈련의 효율성을 높여, 제한된 컴퓨팅 자원으로도 모델 성능을 효과적으로 개선할 수 있는 실용적인 방법을 제공합니다.

items.title: Beyond the Readout: A Latent Numerical Frame Shared Across Modality and Operation
items.body: When a multimodal model computes 17+35 from text or 91-39 from a rendered image, it produces the same answer, 52. Does it use one internal concept of number for both, or separate machinery for each path? Similarity metrics such as RSA or CKA cannot settle this question. They give the same score to identical and to rotated directions, and two representations can look alike only because both prepare the same output digits. We therefore use causal interventions. For four conditions (text or image, addition or subtraction), we learn a small subspace of Gemma4-12B-it's residual stream in which swapping coordinates swaps the model's answer. The subspaces answer three questions. First, do the conditions write numbers along the same directions? They do not. Reusing a subspace from text in an image on the same operation recovers only 53.2% of its causal effect. A single rotation and rescaling maps one subspace onto the other and raises recovery to 91.4%, so the conditions share one geometry expressed in different coordinates. Second, does this shared geometry only reflect the digit the model is about to print? To test this, we split each subspace into 9 directions that the output layer reads to choose the next digit and 13 directions that it cannot see. The 13 hidden directions still carry the number, yet changing them barely alters the digit being written. Third, what are these hidden directions for? A model must emit a multi-digit answer one digit at a time, so it can compute the full result early and keep it in reserve. When two numbers share their first digit, swapping the number in the hidden directions leaves the digit being written intact and redirects the next digit in 77.6% of cases. The model thus forms an abstract numerical concept upstream and unfolds it across time: multimodal representations share meaning through relational geometry across distinct coordinate frames.
items.title_ko: 읽기 전용을 넘어: 양식과 연산 전반에 걸쳐 공유되는 잠재적 수치 프레임
items.summary_ko: 멀티모달 모델이 텍스트에서 '17+35' 또는 렌더링된 이미지에서 '91-39'를 계산할 때, 동일한 답변인 52를 생성합니다. 이 모델이 둘 모두에 대해 하나의 내부 숫자 개념을 사용하는지, 아니면 각 경로에 대해 별도의 메커니즘을 사용하는지에 대한 문제입니다. 이 연구는 인과적 개입을 사용하여 이 질문을 해결합니다.
items.why_ko: 멀티모달 모델이 숫자 개념을 어떻게 내부적으로 표현하고 처리하는지에 대한 깊이 있는 이해를 제공하여, 모델의 추론 능력과 범용성 개선에 기여할 수 있습니다.

items.title: Displacement Moments and Path-Terminal Separation in Brownian Interpolant Sampling
items.body: Brownian stochastic interpolants connect paired endpoint samples, yet their sampling error can depend on displacement moments even when neither endpoint has a first moment. For arbitrary Borel couplings, we prove early-stopped, target-to-output KL guarantees for standard Euler sampling from the true source. A fourth displacement moment gives an explicit $O(N^{-1})$ bound; a second moment suffices for fixed-law convergence as drift error vanishes. For one fixed coupling with no displacement moment above two, original bridge-path KL stays of order one, comparison-path KL is of order $1/\log N$, and terminal KL is at most $C/N^2$ on the same grid. The path decomposition identifies the information about the source discarded by Markov projection. When the original bridge is Markov, current-state Euler sampling instead has a second-moment $O((M_2+d)/N)$ bound; finite-entropy Schroedinger bridges for the probability Brownian reference are included. We also construct a current-state learner with expected output KL consistency from iid endpoint pairs. Numerical diagnostics illustrate the distinct errors. Conditional diffusion identities specify a restoration interface, while image controls find no iterative advantage over cheap probabilistic predictors. Uniform terminal rates for general second-moment couplings remain open.
items.title_ko: 브라운 운동 보간 샘플링의 변위 모멘트 및 경로-종단 분리
items.summary_ko: 브라운 운동 확률적 보간법은 짝지어진 끝점 샘플을 연결하지만, 그 샘플링 오류는 끝점 중 어느 것도 첫 번째 모멘트를 가지지 않을 때조차 변위 모멘트에 의존할 수 있습니다. 이 연구는 임의의 보렐 결합에 대해, 실제 소스에서 표준 오일러 샘플링에 대한 조기 종료된, 목표-출력 KL 보증을 증명합니다.
items.why_ko: 확산 모델의 샘플링 과정에 대한 이론적 이해를 심화하고, 효율적인 샘플링 알고리즘 개발을 위한 수학적 기초를 제공합니다.

items.title: Constraining the Commit Boundary: A DIO/ODI-Informed Authorization Guardrail for Agentic Entity Resolution
items.body:
Agentic Entity Resolution (ER) systems iteratively plan actions, retrieve evidence, revise hypotheses, and propose graph mutations. An erroneous identity hypothesis may condition later retrieval and produce apparent confirmation. This paper proposes a Digital Identity Optimization (DIO) and Ontology of Digital Identity (ODI)-informed authorization boundary between evidence available for agent reasoning and evidence eligible to authorize persistent identity-changing mutations.
A domain-governed constraint-binding function maps selected reconstruction-failure distinctions to explicit identity-preserving constraints. An abstract two-phase supervisor permits a commit only when claim-specific authorization-eligible evidence supports every required proposition, relevant conflicts are resolved, the operation remains within its authorized scope, and relevant state and policy versions remain valid. Admission as UNVERIFIED does not confer authorization eligibility. Separate claim-specific promotion governs evidentiary use; insufficient support or unresolved material conflict leads to deferral.
The contribution is a specification connecting diagnostic-to-constraint mapping, evidence promotion, proposition coverage, conflict handling, scope binding, and commit-time version integrity. A proposed evaluation protocol is designed to assess the mapping's incremental value beyond generic authorization and conventional identifier rules. This is a conceptual architecture without implementation or empirical validation, not a theorem of semantic correctness. Its property depends on domain-policy adequacy, evidence promotion, and enforcement. It does not prevent erroneous hypotheses or hypothesis-conditioned retrieval; dependency-aware evidence flow remains future research.
items.title_ko: 커밋 경계 제약: 에이전트 엔티티 해결을 위한 DIO/ODI 정보 기반 권한 부여 가드레일
items.summary_ko: 에이전트 엔티티 해결(ER) 시스템은 반복적으로 행동을 계획하고, 증거를 검색하고, 가설을 수정하고, 그래프 변이를 제안합니다. 잘못된 식별 가설은 나중에 검색에 영향을 미쳐 명백한 확인을 생성할 수 있습니다. 이 논문은 에이전트 추론에 사용 가능한 증거와 영구적인 신원 변경 변이를 승인하는 데 적합한 증거 사이의 디지털 신원 최적화(DIO) 및 디지털 신원 온톨로지(ODI) 정보 기반 권한 부여 경계를 제안합니다.
items.why_ko: AI 에이전트가 중요한 정보를 다룰 때 발생할 수 있는 오류를 방지하고, 데이터의 무결성과 보안을 강화하는 데 필요한 정책 및 기술적 가드레일을 제시합니다.

items.title: Clearing the FoG: Training KG Agents to Retrieve the Evidence Behind Their Answers
items.body: Large language models (LLMs) can answer many factual questions correctly, but a correct answer is not necessarily a supported one. For an LLM agent, a knowledge graph (KG) plays two roles: as a source of answers, it supplies facts that the model lacks; as a source of evidence, it supplies the supporting triples that make an answer traceable and auditable. However, existing KG agents treat the KG only as a source of answers: their training data carries answers but not evidence, and their training rewards check the answer but not the retrieved evidence, so agents often answer correctly without retrieving the supporting triples. We propose FoG, a framework that trains KG agents to retrieve the evidence behind their answers. FoG consists of evidence-grounded synthesis, a KG interaction agent, and an evidence-coverage process reward (ECPR): the synthesis recursively hides explicit entities behind verifiable sub-questions, so that every question carries its supporting triples by construction; the agent records the triples returned by the KG; and ECPR credits each supporting triple to the turn that first retrieves it. Experiments on three KGQA benchmarks demonstrate that FoG enables 3B--4B open-source agents to outperform substantially larger baselines in answer accuracy and evidence coverage, with zero-shot cross-KG transfer.
items.title_ko: 안개 걷어내기: KG 에이전트가 답변 뒤의 증거를 검색하도록 훈련하기
items.summary_ko: LLM은 많은 사실적 질문에 올바르게 답할 수 있지만, 올바른 답변이 반드시 뒷받침되는 것은 아닙니다. 지식 그래프(KG)는 LLM 에이전트에게 두 가지 역할을 합니다. 이 연구는 기존 KG 에이전트가 KG를 답변의 출처로만 취급하는 한계를 지적하며, KG를 증거의 출처로도 활용하도록 훈련하는 방법을 제안합니다.
items.why_ko: LLM의 답변에 대한 투명성과 신뢰성을 높여, AI가 제공하는 정보의 출처를 명확히 하고 잠재적인 환각을 줄이는 데 중요한 기여를 합니다.

items.title: An end-to-end framework for uncertainty-aware validation of generative models
items.body: Density estimation with generative models is a common task in the physical sciences, for example in background estimation in particle physics. Existing machine learning techniques, however, lack methods to quantify uncertainties that can be propagated into a statistical test. That limits the validation of generative models to standard goodness-of-fit tests, in which the generative model is treated as exact (point-null hypothesis). But a model fitted to a finite training set is never exact, so if its uncertainties are neglected, any sufficiently powerful goodness-of-fit test will eventually reject it once the test set is large enough to resolve this estimation error. We propose SIGMA, an end-to-end framework combining density estimation with principled uncertainty quantification. We use Gaussian mixture models, for which uncertainties are tractable, and further construct a new goodness-of-fit test in which these uncertainties are profiled as nuisance parameters to account for the statistical error of the fit, promoting the conventional point-null test to a composite one. A rejection then signals genuine mismodeling rather than a test set large enough to resolve the error of the fit, provided the propagated uncertainties faithfully cover that error. We demonstrate the framework on a controlled two-dimensional toy model and on a collider physics benchmark modeling the QCD background process. With uncertainties included, the same model can be trusted on test sets up to an order of magnitude larger than the standard test allows. Our work thus provides a statistically grounded basis for a robust use of generative models in the physical sciences.
items.title_ko: 생성 모델의 불확실성 인식 검증을 위한 종단 간 프레임워크
items.summary_ko: 생성 모델을 이용한 밀도 추정은 물리학 등에서 흔한 작업이지만, 기존 기계 학습 기술은 통계 테스트에 전파될 수 있는 불확실성을 정량화하는 방법이 부족합니다. 이 연구는 이러한 문제를 해결하고 생성 모델의 검증을 위한 종단 간 프레임워크를 제안합니다.
items.why_ko: 생성 모델의 신뢰성을 정량적으로 평가하고 불확실성을 관리하는 방법을 제공하여, 과학 연구 및 산업 응용 분야에서 생성 AI의 활용도를 높이는 데 기여합니다.

items.title: Game-Theoretic Solvers with Bayesian Opponent Modeling and Moral Rhetoric Framing for GLEE
items.body: We describe the agent we submitted to the GLEE Competition, which plays bargaining, negotiation, and persuasion games against a shared pool of human and AI opponents. The agent is built around three central components: a classical game-theoretic solver to compute numeric moves, an online Bayesian layer to estimate opponent archetypes, and a language model to write accompanying messages. We utilize Rubinstein bargaining for bargaining, Faratin concession for negotiation, and Kamenica--Gentzkow disclosure for persuasion, and adapt those models to live opponents using two separate layers: a Bayesian estimate of the opponent's hidden discount factor, reservation value, or signaling reliability, and a Thompson sampling bandit over five moral-foundation framings coupled with an evidence-intuition spectrum to establish message register. Most of the development effort went into the recurring problem that theoretically optimal policies perform poorly in certain live settings; we report associated failure modes, guardrails we built, and our hypotheses.
